what: A big slogan band flows endlessly, reverses when scrolling down and returns to its own direction when scrolling up. The whole band shifts +10vw → −10vw while the panel passes from the screen bottom to the top (scrub 0), and when the direction changes the arrow turns a half turn in .5s. One loop lasts 15 × (one set width ÷ screen width) seconds, ×.5 below width 991, ×.25 below 479.

options.speed: Seconds to cross one screen width, default 15 (minal client logo strip 25)
options.dir: With right, it flows to the right (default left)
options.dup: How many extra copies of the set, default 2
options.[data-fx-part=track·set·arrow]: Inside the sliding band (track) one set, with an arrow (arrow) that turns with the direction

use: Your slogan here

from.where: shared.js MN.marquee (slogan band above the footer speed 15 · two customer logo rows flowing opposite to About speed 25)
